NOTICE OF SPECIAL MEETING

  As authorized by California Government Code Section 54956 and Arcadia City
  Charter Section 408, a Special Meeting of the Arcadia City Council is hereby called
  to be held at Le Meridien, 130 W. Huntington Drive, Arcadia, California on
  Thursday, June 13, 2024, at 4:00 p.m.

  1. PUBLIC COMMENT
City Clerk
  Any person wishing to speak before the City Council is asked to complete a
  Speaker Card and submit it by 4:15 p.m. Each speaker is limited to one (1)
  minute per person, unless waived by the City Council.

  2. CALL TO POST & PRESENTATION OF COLORS

  Arcadia Police Department Honor Guard

  3. INVOCATION

  Reverend John M. Scholte

  4. PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

  Arcadia Police Department Honor Guard

  5. STATE OF THE CITY

  April A. Verlato, City of Arcadia Mayor

  6. KEYNOTE SPEAKER

  Mirai Nagasu

  In accordance with the Brown Act, public comments will be limited to addressing
  the item listed on this special meeting agenda. Under the Brown Act, the City
  Council is prohibited from discussing or taking action on any item not listed on the
  posted agenda.

  No other business than the above will be considered at this meeting.
